header.title: SMS
header.subtitle: Connect a Twilio number and let your agent auto-reply to SMS

issues.smsDisabled: Enable SMS to connect a phone number and receive messages.
issues.platformNotConfigured: Twilio credentials are not configured on this deployment.

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prerequisites.description: SMS messaging uses Twilio. You need an SMS-capable phone number and inbound webhooks pointed at Anselio.

webhook.title: Webhook URL
webhook.description: In Twilio Console, set <incomingMessage>When a message comes in</incomingMessage> to this URL (HTTP POST) for your SMS-capable phone number.
webhook.fieldDescription: Phone Numbers → Manage → Active Numbers → select your number → Messaging

steps.title: Twilio Console steps
steps.purchaseNumber: Purchase an SMS-capable phone number in Twilio Console (or use an existing one).
steps.openPhoneNumbers: Open Phone Numbers → Manage → Active Numbers → select your number.
steps.configureWebhook: Under <messaging>Messaging</messaging>, paste the webhook URL above into <incomingMessage>When a message comes in</incomingMessage> (HTTP POST).
steps.connectNumber: Open the <connect>Connect</connect> tab to link your phone number to this agent.

readiness.title: Readiness checklist
readiness.mappingActive: Phone number linked on Connect tab
readiness.ready: All checks passed — send a test SMS to your linked number.
readiness.incomplete: Complete the items above, then configure the Twilio webhook on the Setup tab.

messaging.title: Test messaging
messaging.instructions: From your phone, send a text message to <number>{phoneNumber}</number>. If the webhook is configured, <agent>{agentName}</agent> will reply automatically.
messaging.ratesNotice: Make sure your Twilio number has SMS capabilities enabled. Standard carrier rates apply for outbound messages.

link.title: Link phone number
link.description: Enter the SMS-capable Twilio number customers message (E.164 format). Inbound messages to this number route to this agent.
link.phoneNumberDescription: Must match the number configured in Twilio.
link.reassignmentNotice: If this number is already linked to another agent in your organization, connecting here will reassign inbound traffic to this agent.
